summary: Create an application based on a book, with a voice feature that reads Chinese sentences aloud.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Book cover illustration in a minimalist ink-on-paper style with Chinese calligraphy-like strokes and a subtle bamboo motif (book-cover.dim_1200x1600.png)

existing_features.title: Add React Query hooks for the new backend book/lesson and sentence APIs (list, get details, create/update/delete) following the existing patterns in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts, including cache invalidation for edits.

Add a new ‘Book Reader’ area to the app UI with routing and navigation entry, without breaking existing pages. Include: (1) a library/list page to select a book/lesson, and (2) a reader page that displays the ordered Chinese sentences for the selected content.

Implement in-browser text-to-speech playback for each Chinese sentence in the reader page using the Web Speech API (speechSynthesis). Provide per-sentence controls: Play, Stop, and an option to autoplay the next sentence. Set the utterance language to Chinese (e.g., 'zh-CN') and expose basic controls for rate and pitch.

Add a simple content editor UI to allow entering the book content from the user’s book: create/edit a book/lesson and add/edit/reorder Chinese sentences. This editor must use the backend CRUD APIs (not hardcoded seed-only content).

Apply a cohesive visual theme appropriate for a reading app (e.g., warm paper-like background, high-contrast typography, subtle ink accents) and enforce it consistently across the new Book Reader pages while still fitting the existing Tailwind/shadcn styling system.
Add generated static image assets for the Book Reader module and render them from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve images through the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Build an app based on the provided book content, including text-to-speech voice playback that reads Chinese sentences/phrases aloud.

Add backend support for storing “book-based” Chinese reading content as structured data (e.g., books/lessons with ordered Chinese sentences) and expose query + mutation methods to: (1) list available books/lessons, (2) fetch a single book/lesson with its sentences in order, and (3) create/update/delete books/lessons and sentences.

projectName: Add a Chinese book reader module with text-to-speech playback for Chinese sentences
